name: ateam-ksa-health-compliance
description: Checks a healthcare software system against Saudi Arabia's healthcare rules (PDPL and data transfers, NCA cybersecurity controls, CST cloud, MoH/NHIC health information exchange policies, telehealth, CHI/NPHIES and SFDA software and AI medical device rules) and produces a sourced engineering checklist as a tracked register and an Excel file, then re-checks as engineers close the gaps.
